name: authState
doc: Answers what the sign-in screen offers: setup, the sign-in methods and what needs HTTPS.

name: authSetupPassword
doc: Creates the first account with a password and answers a session or a pending sign-in.

name: authSetupPasskeyBegin
doc: Starts the passkey registration that creates the first account.

name: authSetupPasskeyFinish
doc: Finishes the first account's passkey registration and signs it in.

name: authLoginPassword
doc: Signs in with a password and answers a session or a pending sign-in.

name: authLoginCode
doc: Completes a pending sign-in with an authenticator app code.

name: authLoginSecondPasskeyBegin
doc: Starts the passkey assertion that completes a pending sign-in.

name: authLoginSecondPasskeyFinish
doc: Finishes the passkey assertion that completes a pending sign-in.

name: authLoginRecoveryCode
doc: Checks a recovery code on a pending sign-in and answers the step that enrols a new second factor.

name: authLoginSetPassword
doc: Sets the password chosen after a temporary password and answers a session or a pending sign-in.

name: authLoginSetPasskeyBegin
doc: Starts the passkey registration that replaces a temporary password.

name: authLoginSetPasskeyFinish
doc: Finishes the passkey registration that replaces a temporary password and signs in.

name: authPendingTOTPBegin
doc: Draws an authenticator app secret for a pending sign-in to enrol.

name: authPendingTOTPFinish
doc: Enrols a pending sign-in's authenticator app with its first code and signs in.

name: authPendingPasskeyBegin
doc: Starts the passkey registration a pending sign-in enrols.

name: authPendingPasskeyFinish
doc: Finishes a pending sign-in's passkey registration and signs in.

name: authLoginPasskeyBegin
doc: Starts a passkey sign-in.

name: authLoginPasskeyFinish
doc: Finishes a passkey sign-in and answers the session.

name: authLogout
doc: Ends the presented session and clears its cookie.

name: authOIDCStartSignIn
doc: Redirects to the identity provider to sign in.

name: authOIDCStartLink
doc: Answers the identity provider URL that links an identity to the signed-in account.

name: authOIDCStartStepUp
doc: Answers the identity provider URL that steps up the current session.

name: authInviteAcceptOIDC
doc: Answers the identity provider URL that accepts an invite by single sign-on.

name: authOIDCCallback
doc: Completes a flow the identity provider sent back and redirects into the app.

name: authOIDCPending
doc: Answers the identity waiting to be linked or turned into an account.

name: authOIDCCreatePending
doc: Creates an account for the waiting identity under a chosen username and signs it in.

name: authOIDCLinkByAdmin
doc: Links the waiting identity to an account named with the temporary password an admin issued it, and signs it in.

name: authOIDCLinkPending
doc: Links the waiting identity to the signed-in account.

name: authOIDCUnlink
doc: Unlinks the signed-in account's single sign-on identity.

name: authInviteAcceptPassword
doc: Accepts an invite with a password and answers a session or a pending sign-in.

name: authMe
doc: Answers the signed-in account, its session and its sign-in methods.

name: authProfile
doc: Updates the signed-in account's profile.

name: authMethodReenable
doc: Unlocks a sign-in method locked after repeated failures.

name: authStepUpPassword
doc: Steps up the current session with the account's password.

name: authStepUpPasskeyBegin
doc: Starts the passkey assertion that steps up the current session.

name: authStepUpPasskeyFinish
doc: Finishes the passkey assertion that steps up the current session.

name: authStepUpCode
doc: Steps up the current session with an authenticator app code.

name: authPasswordSet
doc: Sets or changes the account's password and answers any new recovery code.

name: authPasswordRemove
doc: Removes the account's password.

name: authTOTPBegin
doc: Draws a new authenticator app secret for the account to enrol.

name: authTOTPFinish
doc: Enrols or replaces the account's authenticator app and answers any new recovery code.

name: authRecoveryCodeRegenerate
doc: Replaces the account's recovery code after a second-factor proof.

name: authTOTPRemove
doc: Removes the account's authenticator app.

name: authPasskeys
doc: Lists the account's passkeys.

name: authPasskeyRegisterBegin
doc: Starts registering a new passkey on the account.

name: authPasskeyRegisterFinish
doc: Finishes registering a passkey and answers it with any new recovery code.

name: authPasskeyRename
doc: Renames one of the account's passkeys.

name: authPasskeyRemove
doc: Removes one of the account's passkeys.

name: authWebAuthnSignals
doc: Answers the passkeys and user details the browser's WebAuthn signal calls report.

name: authSessions
doc: Lists the account's sessions.

name: authSessionRename
doc: Renames one of the account's sessions.

name: authSessionRevoke
doc: Ends one of the account's sessions.

name: authSessionsRevokeOthers
doc: Ends every session of the account but the current one.

name: authKeys
doc: Lists the account's API keys.

name: authKeyCreate
doc: Creates an API key and answers its secret once.

name: authKeyRename
doc: Renames one of the account's API keys.

name: authKeyRotate
doc: Replaces an API key's secret and answers the new one once.

name: authKeyRevoke
doc: Revokes one of the account's API keys.

name: authAdminUsers
doc: Lists the app's accounts with their sign-in methods.

name: authAdminUserCreate
doc: Creates an account.

name: authAdminUserUpdate
doc: Changes an account's role or whether it is enabled.

name: authAdminOwner
doc: Makes an account an owner or removes its owner flag.

name: authAdminSSOReadiness
doc: Answers what applying a single sign-on mode would change, or why it is refused.

name: authAdminSSOApply
doc: Applies a single sign-on mode to the app.

name: authAdminUserDelete
doc: Deletes an account.

name: authAdminOIDCUnlink
doc: Unlinks an account's single sign-on identity.

name: authAdminOIDCRelink
doc: Unlinks an account's single sign-on identity, issues it a temporary password and answers it once.

name: authAdminTemporaryPassword
doc: Issues an account a temporary password and answers it once.

name: authAdminSecondFactorReset
doc: Deletes an account's authenticator app and recovery code and ends its sessions.

name: authAdminInvite
doc: Creates an invite and answers its token once.

name: authAdminKeys
doc: Lists every account's API keys.

name: authAdminKeyRevoke
doc: Revokes any account's API key.

name: authAdminTokens
doc: Lists the unspent one-time tokens, such as invites.

name: authAdminSecurityLog
doc: Answers a page of the security log.
